name: Hongguo Download
tagline: A lightweight Linux/Windows desktop downloader for Hongguo short dramas, with batch episode downloads.
description:
Hongguo Download is a Tauri-based desktop app for saving Hongguo short-drama episodes for personal offline viewing.

- Lightweight Tauri 2 shell with a Rust backend; no Electron.
- Linux and Windows builds from the same codebase.
- Resolve a share link, select episodes by range, and download in batches.
- Default App source uses an anonymous device identity; no account login is required.
- Optional 360p web source and an in-app web login fallback.
- Resumable downloads, per-episode progress, cancellation, and cross-platform file naming.

> For personal use only. Respect Hongguo's terms of service and local copyright law. This is an unofficial tool and does not grant rights to redistribute content.
